inputs.text:
Let’s be completely clear about what we are witnessing here. On March 26, 2026, the state demonstrated its commitment to upholding entrenched labor hierarchies and protecting global capital by giving royal assent to Bill C-12, officially titled the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act. 

This is not about management or the public interest; it is institutional power weaponizing borders to criminalize Black and brown bodies. By imposing harsher immigration and asylum rules that slam the door on Nigerians and other vulnerable populations, this legislation actively punishes people who are simply trying to survive the devastation wreaked by global inequality and imperialist exploitation. 

You cannot reform a system built from the ground up on exclusion and discrimination. We are looking at a ruling class ruthlessly tightening the screws of global apartheid and systemic xenophobia, and it demands radical institutional reform and the total dismantling of these hostile immigration regimes for the unconditional protection of the most vulnerable.
